rules.name: recon-dup-05-whole-table-duplicates
rules.sql: SELECT g.business_unit, g.settlement_date, g.run_id, g.rows_in_run, g.distinct_trade_id, g.distinct_wide_key, g.rows_in_run - g.distinct_wide_key AS extra_rows_wide_key, g.rows_in_run - g.distinct_trade_id AS extra_rows_trade_id, (p.published_run_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_published, r.status AS run_status, r.row_count AS run_row_count, g.first_created, g.last_created FROM ( SELECT s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, count(*) AS rows_in_run, count(DISTINCT s.trade_id) AS distinct_trade_id, count(DISTINCT md5(concat_ws('|', s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.portfolio, s.value_date, s.parent_trade_id, s.derivative_type, s.instrument_class))) AS distinct_wide_key, min(s.created_timestamp) AS first_created, max(s.created_timestamp) AS last_created FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id ) g LEFT JOIN opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p ON p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = g.business_unit AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING' AND p.settlement_date = g.settlement_date AND p.published_run_id = g.run_id LEFT JOIN opera.recon_refresh_run r ON r.uuid = g.run_id ORDER BY extra_rows_wide_key DESC, g.rows_in_run DESC

SELECT g.business_unit, g.settlement_date, g.run_id, g.rows_in_run, g.distinct_trade_id, g.distinct_wide_key, g.rows_in_run - g.distinct_wide_key AS extra_rows_wide_key, g.rows_in_run - g.distinct_trade_id AS extra_rows_trade_id, (p.published_run_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_published, r.status AS run_status, r.row_count AS run_row_count, g.first_created, g.last_created FROM ( SELECT s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, count(*) AS rows_in_run, count(DISTINCT s.trade_id) AS distinct_trade_id, count(DISTINCT md5(concat_ws('|', s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.portfolio, s.value_date, s.parent_trade_id, s.derivative_type, s.instrument_class))) AS distinct_wide_key, min(s.created_timestamp) AS first_created, max(s.created_timestamp) AS last_created FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id ) g LEFT JOIN opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p ON p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = g.business_unit AND p.view_type = 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING' AND p.settlement_date = g.settlement_date AND p.published_run_id = g.run_id LEFT JOIN opera.recon_refresh_run r ON r.uuid = g.run_id ORDER BY extra_rows_wide_key DESC, g.rows_in_run DESC

SELECT s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, count(DISTINCT s.run_id) AS runs_with_rows, count(*) AS total_rows FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date HAVING count(DISTINCT s.run_id) > 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, count(DISTINCT s.run_id) AS runs_with_rows, count(*) AS total_rows FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date HAVING count(DISTINCT s.run_id) > 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.value_date, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT s.created_timestamp) AS n_created_timestamps, min(s.created_timestamp) AS first_created, max(s.created_timestamp) AS last_created, string_agg(DISTINCT s.created_by, ',') AS created_by_users, string_agg(DISTINCT s.source_trade_id, ',') AS source_trade_ids FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.value_date HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC, s.business_unit, s.trade_id LIMIT 30

SELECT s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.value_date, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT s.created_timestamp) AS n_created_timestamps, min(s.created_timestamp) AS first_created, max(s.created_timestamp) AS last_created, string_agg(DISTINCT s.created_by, ',') AS created_by_users FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit, s.settlement_date, s.run_id, s.trade_id, s.security_id, s.subportfolio, s.value_date HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC, s.business_unit, s.trade_id LIMIT 30

the tenant has actual snapshot rows
no run holds duplicate rows in recon_settle_snapshot
no run holds duplicate rows in recon_actual_snapshot
every settle run that holds rows is published
every actual run that holds rows is published
